heading.en: Diplomatic career and the Washington legation

body.zh-Hant: 卡洛斯·雷斯特雷波政府時期（1910至1914年），他擔任外交部長，後來出任駐阿根廷公使。1922年起他出任哥倫比亞駐美國公使；一位自由黨人在保守黨政權下擔任這個職位，處境微妙。他留在華盛頓，直到1930年1月中旬才離開。
body.en: During the administration of Carlos E. Restrepo (1910-1914) he was foreign minister and later minister to Argentina. From 1922 he was Colombian minister to the United States, a delicate position for a Liberal under a Conservative regime. He remained in Washington until mid-January 1930.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年大選中，自由黨以「全國集中」運動之名推出奧拉亞·埃雷拉，保守黨則分裂為兩名候選人，即吉列爾莫·巴倫西亞與阿爾弗雷多·巴斯克斯·科沃。他在1930年2月9日獲勝，結束了45年的保守黨霸權。
body.en: In the 1930 election the Liberals backed Olaya Herrera under the banner of the National Concentration, while the Conservatives split between two candidates, Guillermo Valencia and Alfredo Vásquez Cobo. His victory on 9 February 1930 ended 45 years of Conservative hegemony.

body.zh-Hant: 奧拉亞·埃雷拉的政府面對嚴重的黨派暴力，特別是在東北部；他以正統做法應付大蕭條，直到1933年4月才暫停支付外債利息。1931年頒布勞動法典。面對秘魯奪取亞馬遜港口萊蒂西亞，他大規模動員，事件最後經談判解決。卸任後他出任駐梵蒂岡公使，1937年2月18日去世。
body.en: His government faced serious partisan violence, particularly in the northeast. He met the Great Depression with orthodoxy and suspended interest payments on the foreign debt only in April 1933. The Labor Code dated from 1931. When Peru seized the Amazon port of Leticia he mobilized on a large scale, and the matter was settled by negotiation. After his term he was minister to the Vatican, and he died on 18 February 1937.

body.zh-Hant: 胡佛1874年8月10日生於愛荷華州西布蘭奇，母親是教友派（貴格會）的登記傳道人。他九歲成為孤兒，1885年11月十一歲時離開愛荷華，前往奧勒岡投靠舅舅。三年後他決定當礦業工程師，申請就讀新設立的史丹佛大學，在校擔任學生會司庫與棒球、美式足球隊經理，1895年畢業。
body.en: Hoover was born on 10 August 1874 in West Branch, Iowa; his mother was a recorded minister in the Society of Friends (Quakers). Orphaned at nine, he left Iowa in November 1885, aged eleven, for his uncle's home in Oregon. Having decided on a career as a mining engineer, he applied to the new Stanford University, where he served as student body treasurer and manager of the baseball and football teams, and graduated in 1895.

heading.zh-Hant: 礦業工程師與比利時救濟

body.zh-Hant: 1895年畢業後的二十年間，胡佛以國際礦業工程師與金融家的身分累積財富。1914年第一次世界大戰爆發時，他住在倫敦，隨即為逃離戰區的美國旅客組織協助；數週後他設立比利時救濟委員會，為困在戰區的比利時平民提供糧食。
body.en: In the two decades after graduating in 1895, Hoover made his fortune as an international mining engineer and financier. When the First World War broke out in 1914 he was living in London and at once organized assistance for American travelers fleeing the war; a few weeks later he established the Commission for Relief in Belgium to provide food for Belgian civilians trapped in the war zone.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年美國參戰，威爾遜總統任命已是知名人道主義者的胡佛，擔任新設的美國糧食署首長。糧食署以政府大量採購影響市價，大幅提高農業產量，並呼籲民眾自願減少消費，而不採配給。1918年戰爭結束後，胡佛回到歐洲，出任美國救濟署（American Relief Administration）總署長，在歐洲各地分發糧食與救濟物資。
body.en: In 1917, after the United States entered the war, President Wilson appointed Hoover, by then a famous humanitarian, head of the new U.S. Food Administration. It raised farm production sharply by influencing prices through large government purchases, and asked the public to cut consumption voluntarily instead of using rationing. When the war ended in 1918, Hoover returned to Europe as director-general of the American Relief Administration to distribute food and relief supplies across Europe.

heading.en: Secretary of Commerce and the 1928 nomination

body.zh-Hant: 1920年胡佛是共和黨總統提名的競爭者之一，但未獲提名；哈定贏得白宮後任命他為商務部長，他在哈定與柯立芝兩任政府中續任。他在商務部推動製成品標準化，倡導減少工業浪費，並鼓勵無線電與航空等新興產業。1927年密西西比河大水後，他主持救災。1928年柯立芝不再競選，胡佛輕易取得共和黨提名，並在11月大選中擊敗民主黨的艾爾·史密斯。
body.en: In 1920 Hoover was a contender for the Republican presidential nomination, but it was blocked; Warren Harding won the White House and appointed him secretary of commerce, a post he kept under Coolidge. At Commerce he set standards for manufactured products, campaigned against waste in industry and encouraged new industries such as radio and aviation. In 1927 he took charge of relief after the Mississippi River floods. In 1928, with Coolidge not running again, he easily won the Republican nomination and defeated Al Smith in the November election.

body.zh-Hant: 埃梅斯·羅德里格斯·達豐塞卡1855年5月12日生於南大河州的聖加夫列爾，父親是官至元帥的軍人，叔父德奧多羅·達豐塞卡是共和國的締造者與首任總統。1871年他入伍，同年進入巴西軍事學校，1876年晉升少尉。1900年晉升准將；1904年出任雷阿連戈預備與戰術學校校長，並在11月鎮壓學生參與疫苗反抗運動。1905年他成為少將。
body.en: Hermes Rodrigues da Fonseca was born on 12 May 1855 in São Gabriel, Rio Grande do Sul, the son of an army marshal and nephew of Deodoro da Fonseca, who proclaimed the Republic and became its first president. He enlisted in 1871, entered the Military School the same year and became a second lieutenant in 1876. He was promoted brigadier general in 1900, took command of the Realengo preparatory and tactical school in 1904, and put down the students' part in the Vaccine Revolt that November. In 1905 he became a major general.

body.zh-Hant: 1906年11月6日他晉升元帥，阿方索·佩納就任總統後，他被任命為陸軍部長，接替阿爾戈洛將軍。任內他推動陸軍現代化，加強與德國的外交關係，意圖採用德國的軍事教育模式；並獲德皇威廉二世邀請赴德觀看陸軍演習。1908年的義務兵役法確立徵兵與抽籤制度。1909年5月27日，他為參選總統而離開陸軍部，由盧伊斯·門德斯·德莫賴斯將軍接任。
body.en: He was promoted marshal on 6 November 1906 and, after Afonso Pena took office as president, was appointed minister of war, replacing General Argolo. In office he pushed the modernization of the army and strengthened diplomatic ties with Germany, hoping to adopt its model of military instruction; Kaiser Wilhelm II invited him to watch German army manoeuvres. The 1908 compulsory military service law set up conscription by lottery. On 27 May 1909 he left the ministry to run for president and was succeeded by General Luís Mendes de Morais.

body.zh-Hant: 1909年5月22日，參眾議員大會在參議員平海羅·馬沙多召集下正式提名他為反對派候選人。魯伊·巴爾博薩出面對壘，發起以反軍國主義為核心的「文人運動」。1910年3月1日投票，達豐塞卡以403,867票對222,822票勝出，雙方互相指控舞弊。他在1910年11月15日宣誓就任。
body.en: On 22 May 1909 a convention of senators and deputies organized by Senator Pinheiro Machado formally launched him as the opposition candidate. Rui Barbosa ran against him, organizing the Civilista Campaign around opposition to militarism. In the vote of 1 March 1910 Hermes won with 403,867 votes to Barbosa's 222,822, amid mutual charges of fraud. He took office on 15 November 1910.

body.zh-Hant: 就職第一週的1910年11月22日，水兵在瓜納巴拉灣發動「鞭刑反抗」，政府於26日宣布接受要求，但隨後鎮壓。他的政府以「拯救政策」著稱，以選舉操作或軍事力量，用較可信賴的集團取代各州掌權者。1914年3月4日政府在聯邦區與尼泰羅伊宣布戒嚴。1914年11月15日，他把總統職位移交給文塞斯勞·布拉斯。
body.en: In the first week of the new government, on 22 November 1910, sailors on ships in Guanabara Bay mutinied in the Revolt of the Lash; on the 26th the government announced it accepted their demands, but repression followed. His government was known for the politics of the "salvations", replacing groups in power in the states with others he trusted, by electoral manoeuvre or military force. On 4 March 1914 a state of siege was decreed in the Federal District and Niterói. On 15 November 1914 he handed the presidency to Venceslau Brás.

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後他退居彼得羅波利斯；1915年8月他在選舉中獲選聯邦參議員，但在同年9月放棄任期，前往德國，在瑞士住到1920年10月。同年12月，軍官推舉他接任軍人俱樂部主席，次年5月就任。1922年6月29日他以主席身分發電報給累西腓守軍，勸士兵勿鎮壓人民，7月2日被捕。7月5日，維拉軍營、雷阿連戈軍校與科帕卡巴納要塞的軍人起事，這是尉官運動的第一次表現。他於1923年9月9日在彼得羅波利斯去世。
body.en: After leaving office he retired to Petrópolis; in August 1915 he won election to the Federal Senate but gave up the mandate in September 1915 and travelled to Germany, then lived in Switzerland until October 1920. In December that year officers put his name forward to succeed General Crispim as president of the Military Club, a post he took up in May of the following year. On 29 June 1922, as its president, he telegraphed the federal garrison in Recife urging soldiers not to repress the people, and on 2 July he was arrested. On 5 July soldiers rose at the Vila Militar, the Realengo Military School and Copacabana Fort, the first manifestation of tenentismo. He died in Petrópolis on 9 September 1923.
